## About
Lents Body Shop got its start in the back of a gas station on Foster, and it has been part of this neighborhood ever since. Today we're still on SE Foster Road, still a family run shop doing auto body repair and paint.
Jim and Dawn McCoy bought the shop from Randy Dagel, who wanted it to stay a family run business in the Lents neighborhood. Jim had been general manager of Alpine Auto Body in Vancouver and missed the small family run feeling. Dawn works in the office as our customer experience representative, so she's usually one of the first smiling faces you'll meet.
We try to treat each person who walks through the door as an individual, whether that means calling your insurance company, getting you into a rental or giving you a ride home. We're rated 4.8 from 377 Google reviews, and we work to keep earning that.

## Services
- Collision Repair: We start with a computerized damage estimate and digital photos of the damage to your vehicle.
- Body work and paint: Frame straightening, paint color matching and skilled body repair, from simple door dings and dents to heavily damaged cars, trucks, vans and SUVs.
- Paint less Dent Removal: Dents taken out without repainting when the damage allows it.
- Towing: 24 hour towing provided by Elite Towing.
- Rental Car Acquisition: We help get you into a rental through Enterprise Car Rental Service while your car is in the shop.
- Complete detail interior and exterior: A full detail inside and out. One reviewer said we detailed her car inside and out after her repair.

## FAQ
Q: I've just been in an accident. What do I do now?
A: Give us a call. Our online guide walks you through the steps to getting you and your car back on the road.

Q: Can you send my estimate to my insurance company?
A: Yes. With your approval, we can e-mail, fax or send your estimate and damage photos directly to your insurance company or another involved party to speed up repairs.

Q: Do your repairs come with a warranty?
A: Yes, we offer a Lifetime Warranty. Ask us about the details when you come in for your estimate.

Q: How do I get home after I drop off my car?
A: We can help you get into a rental, or give you a ride home if you need one.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
